dispositions.reason: PR106 current-source review at public/portal.js:4900:3. The API reads request rows through absenceManagement vacationHistory/timeOffHistory. id is the integer primary key emitted as a JSON numeric value; POST creates an autoincrement key and never copies a body-supplied ID. Approved time-off rows also originate from this request table. This is a typed persistence producer boundary. Current normal request creation, updates and transition methods write status as fixed SQL literals (pending_local, preliminary_local, pending_hr, approved, rejected, withdrawn, cancelled); user input never supplies the stored status. The renderer thus receives a bounded state under these current write paths. SQL request-history JSON projects the stored value without validation, and the schema has no status CHECK: this review does not extend that claim to arbitrary modified database files or historically corrupted/imported status text. Existing individual producer/guard review retained after exact complete-span comparison; current source/context differences were reviewed for this backport. This source review does not establish scanner completeness; the mandatory full qualified Linux SAST must independently match every exact identity and source hash. Header delta review: the sole server change replaces the identical two-value Content-Type ternary with explicit literal CSV/XLSX branches. Body generation, authorization, attachments and all other statements are unchanged. The native payroll unsafe controls remain mandatory; its now-explicitly-typed response finding is removed rather than exempted.

dispositions.reason: PR106 current-source review at public/portal.js:5208:3. The API reads request rows through absenceManagement vacationHistory/timeOffHistory. id is the integer primary key emitted as a JSON numeric value; POST creates an autoincrement key and never copies a body-supplied ID. Approved time-off rows also originate from this request table. This is a typed persistence producer boundary. Current normal request creation, updates and transition methods write status as fixed SQL literals (pending_local, preliminary_local, pending_hr, approved, rejected, withdrawn, cancelled); user input never supplies the stored status. The renderer thus receives a bounded state under these current write paths. SQL request-history JSON projects the stored value without validation, and the schema has no status CHECK: this review does not extend that claim to arbitrary modified database files or historically corrupted/imported status text. Existing individual producer/guard review retained after exact complete-span comparison; current source/context differences were reviewed for this backport. This source review does not establish scanner completeness; the mandatory full qualified Linux SAST must independently match every exact identity and source hash. Header delta review: the sole server change replaces the identical two-value Content-Type ternary with explicit literal CSV/XLSX branches. Body generation, authorization, attachments and all other statements are unchanged. The native payroll unsafe controls remain mandatory; its now-explicitly-typed response finding is removed rather than exempted.
